paragraphs.en: sdl accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still requires extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the sbl ( sbl ), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. We validate sbl ’s end-to-end capabilities through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment. By shifting the role of human researchers from manually configuring and programming device automation to specifying scientific objectives, sbl makes scientific automation more accessible, flexible, and scalable.
paragraphs.zh: SDL 通过自动化实验执行与优化，加速科学发现。 AI 智能体能够越来越多地提出新的实验方案，但现有的 SDL 只能运行其最初设计时指定的程序。 要将它们适应新实验，仍然需要大量的人工工程改造，这使得实验室的灵活性成为扩大发现规模的关键瓶颈。 我们提出了 sbl（sbl），它能够在给定高层科学目标的情况下，自行设计、配置并操作实验室设置。 SBL 可以从任何现有条件出发——无论是空房间还是已运行的 SDL——并构建缺失的能力：实验室布局、其数字孪生体、机器人技能以及实验工作流程。 我们展示了该系统在不同机器人和设置中的运行效果，其规模可从单个工作站扩展至多个机器人协同工作的实验室。 我们通过一个真实的量子点合成实验，验证了 sbl 的全流程能力。 通过将人类研究人员的角色从手动配置和编程设备自动化转变为指定科学目标，sbl 使科学自动化变得更加易用、灵活且可扩展。

paragraphs.en: This boundary becomes a bottleneck as scientific research evolves. New research questions may require experimental procedures or instrumentation that were not anticipated when the platform was configured. Extending these capabilities typically requires specialists to integrate hardware and develop the software needed to execute new procedures [ 17 , 12 , 18 ] . Such modifications are time-consuming [ 19 ] and often depend on tacit knowledge that is difficult to preserve or transfer [ 20 ] . Changes in equipment placement or laboratory layout can further compromise the reliability of existing workflows. Modular platforms and robots that reconfigure equipment can adapt workflows using existing hardware and software [ 21 , 4 , 22 ] . Capabilities beyond those already available still require human development.
paragraphs.zh: 随着科学研究的发展，这一界限会成为瓶颈。 新的研究问题可能需要实验程序或设备，而这些在平台配置时并未预料到。 扩展这些功能通常需要专家集成硬件并开发执行新程序所需的软件 [ 17 , 12 , 18 ] 。 此类修改既耗时 [ 19 ]，又常常依赖于难以保留或传递的默会知识 [ 20 ] 。 设备位置或实验室布局的变化可能进一步削弱现有工作流程的可靠性。 模块化平台和能够重新配置设备的机器人可以利用现有的硬件和软件来调整工作流程 [ 21 , 4 , 22 ] 。 超出已有功能的能力仍然需要人类进行开发。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances provide an opportunity to address this limitation. llm ( llm )-based agents have demonstrated the ability to plan experiments, generate instrument control code, and interact with laboratory hardware [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] , while physics-based simulation enables developing digital twins of laboratory environments [ 31 , 32 ] . Advances in robotics, particularly mobile manipulation, allow experiments to draw on instruments distributed across a laboratory by transferring samples between instruments [ 6 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] . Language models can select existing robot skills based on their likelihood of success [ 37 ] and generate control programs that use sensory feedback [ 38 ] . Using robots as tools for general-purpose agents has also been discussed as a broader direction for robotics [ 39 ] . Recent studies test GPT-6-Astra for robot control in simulation [ 40 , 41 , 42 ] . Experiments and technical reports also show control of real robots, with some systems reusing experience or using a digital twin to guide actions [ 43 , 44 , 45 ] . These advances support flexible experimental execution, but adapting a laboratory to new scientific requirements still requires substantial time and expertise [ 46 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的进展为解决这一局限性提供了机会。基于 llm（llm）的智能体已展现出规划实验、生成仪器控制代码以及与实验室硬件交互的能力 [23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30]，而基于物理的模拟则使得开发实验室环境的数字孪生成为可能 [31, 32]。 机器人技术的进步，尤其是移动操作技术，使得实验可以利用分布在实验室各处的仪器，通过在不同仪器间转移样本来实现 [6, 33, 34, 35, 36]。 语言模型能够根据成功可能性选择现有的机器人技能 [37]，并生成利用感官反馈的控制程序 [38]。 将机器人作为通用智能体的工具使用，也被视为机器人技术的一个更广泛方向 [39]。 近期的研究在模拟环境中测试了 GPT-6-Astra 的机器人控制能力 [40, 41, 42]。 实验和技术报告也展示了真实机器人的控制应用，其中一些系统会复用经验或借助数字孪生来指导操作 [43, 44, 45]。 这些进展支持了灵活的实验执行，但要将实验室适应新的科学需求，仍然需要大量时间和专业知识 [46]。

paragraphs.en: Here, we demonstrate a sbl ( sbl ) that incorporates the identification, development, and validation of task-required operational capabilities into the autonomous scientific process ( Figure 1 ). Researchers define the scientific objectives that guide this process. sbl self-identifies gaps between these objectives and its available capabilities, then develops or extends the interfaces, skills, and workflows needed to address them. The system uses a digital twin to develop candidate operations and check them against task constraints before refining and validating them through physical interaction. Successful procedures are retained as reusable skills for subsequent tasks. Table 1 compares how experimental capabilities are developed and used across laboratory paradigms.

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate capability development of sbl from digital twin construction and operational skill development to experimental workflow building and laboratory expansion. sbl constructs task-relevant digital twins and develops execution interfaces and reusable skills that incorporate sensory feedback. It combines these capabilities into experimental workflows for physical execution using existing instruments. In simulation, the system also coordinates different robotic configurations and interconnected workstations. By incorporating capability development into the autonomous scientific process, sbl could reduce the engineering effort required to adapt laboratory automation to new scientific objectives and make it more accessible to researchers without specialized automation expertise.

paragraphs.en: sbl takes a user’s scientific goal together with a description of the current laboratory: photographs of the space, device identifiers, and any existing automation interfaces ( Figure 2 ). The starting point can range from an empty room to a working sdl ; in each case, sbl builds the capabilities missing for the goal: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows ( Table 2 ). It builds a digital twin of the laboratory, from individual device models to the layout of the whole space, using robot-mounted cameras where available to gather additional observations ( Section 2.2 ). sbl identifies the capabilities the desired workflow requires and acquires the missing skills using the digital twin and, with user approval, trial-and-error in the real world ( Section 2.3 ). This allows it to go from a user’s scientific goal to safely executing the desired workflow in the real world, with minimal human intervention ( Section 2.4 ). The same process extends to designing laboratory layouts and coordinating several robots across workstations ( Section 2.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: sbl 会获取用户的科学目标以及当前实验室的描述，包括空间照片、设备标识符和任何现有的自动化接口（图 2）。 初始状态可以是一个空房间，也可以是一个正在运行的 sdl；无论哪种情况，sbl 都会构建实现该目标所欠缺的能力，包括实验室布局、其数字孪生体、机器人技能以及实验工作流程（表 2）。 sbl 会构建实验室的数字孪生体，从单个设备模型到整个空间布局，并在可用时利用安装在机器人上的摄像头收集更多观察数据（第 2.2 节）。sbl 会识别所需工作流程所依赖的能力，并利用数字孪生体获取缺失的技能，在获得用户批准后，通过真实世界中的试错方法进一步学习（第 2.3 节）。 这使得 sbl 能够从用户的科学目标出发，最终以最小程度的人工干预，在真实世界中安全地执行所需的工作流程（第 2.4 节）。 同样的过程也适用于实验室布局的设计以及多个机器人跨工作站的协调（第 2.5 节）。

sents.en: It builds a digital twin of the laboratory, from individual device models to the layout of the whole space, using robot-mounted cameras where available to gather additional observations ( Section 2.2 ). sbl identifies the capabilities the desired workflow requires and acquires the missing skills using the digital twin and, with user approval, trial-and-error in the real world ( Section 2.3 ).
sents.zh: sbl 会构建实验室的数字孪生体，从单个设备模型到整个空间布局，并在可用时利用安装在机器人上的摄像头收集更多观察数据（第 2.2 节）。sbl 会识别所需工作流程所依赖的能力，并利用数字孪生体获取缺失的技能，在获得用户批准后，通过真实世界中的试错方法进一步学习（第 2.3 节）。

sents.en: This allows it to go from a user’s scientific goal to safely executing the desired workflow in the real world, with minimal human intervention ( Section 2.4 ).
sents.zh: 这使得 sbl 能够从用户的科学目标出发，最终以最小程度的人工干预，在真实世界中安全地执行所需的工作流程（第 2.4 节）。

sents.en: The same process extends to designing laboratory layouts and coordinating several robots across workstations ( Section 2.5 ).
sents.zh: 同样的过程也适用于实验室布局的设计以及多个机器人跨工作站的协调（第 2.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Equipment reconstruction begins with identifying the individual devices from the photographs and any supplied model numbers. For each device, the agent first searches for existing cad ( cad ) models and urdf ( urdf ) files. If these are unavailable, the agent reconstructs an approximate 3D model using manufacturer documentation, technical specifications, and reference images. The agent first estimates the device dimensions using available measurements and known reference objects, then breaks down the device into individual components, such as frames, housings, doors, and moving mechanisms. Using Python, the agent constructs these components from basic geometric primitives and custom meshes. The generated models are then iteratively refined by comparing rendered views against reference images and adjusting their geometry, proportions, and relative positions. Once the geometry is established, the agent adds articulations for movable components by defining their joints, motion axes, and limits. This process produces simulation-ready equipment models without requiring manual CAD modelling. Missing or uncertain parameters are recorded for further refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 设备重建首先需要根据照片和任何提供的型号编号，识别出各个独立设备。 对于每个设备，智能体首先会搜索现有的 CAD (cad) 模型和 URDF (urdf) 文件。 如果这些文件不可用，智能体将利用制造商文档、技术规格和参考图像重建一个近似的三维模型。 智能体首先利用现有测量数据和已知的参考物体估算设备尺寸，然后将设备分解为独立组件，例如框架、外壳、门和移动机构。 智能体使用 Python，通过基础几何原语和自定义网格构建这些组件。 随后，通过渲染视图与参考图像进行对比，并调整其几何形状、比例和相对位置，对生成的模型进行迭代优化。 一旦几何结构确定，智能体便通过定义关节、运动轴和限制来为可移动组件添加活动连接。 这一过程无需手动进行 CAD 建模，即可生成可用于模拟的设备模型。 缺失或不确定的参数会被记录下来，以便后续进一步优化。

paragraphs.en: The agent then assembles the equipment models into an initial scene based on the observed laboratory layout. To refine this arrangement, the agent plans camera poses and acquires colour and depth observations from each pose using its wrist-mounted camera. The agent compares observed and rendered views and iteratively updates equipment positions and orientations. This procedure reduces equipment-pose discrepancies and establishes the robot-to-device poses needed for motion planning.

paragraphs.en: To support operations within the reconstructed scene, the agent implements simulated devices with the same api interfaces as their physical counterparts but different endpoints. Selecting the target endpoint determines whether an operation runs in the twin or the physical laboratory. A monitoring system polls physical device status through the api and updates the corresponding states in the twin. Using the calibrated scene, the agent plans robot motion in the twin and sends the resulting trajectories to the physical execution endpoint to control the robot. The twin remains a living replica of the physical laboratory, continually updated as new observations become available.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持在重建场景中的操作，该智能体实现了与物理设备具有相同 API 接口但不同端点的模拟设备。 选择目标端点可决定操作是在孪生场景中运行还是在物理实验室中运行。 监控系统通过 API 轮询物理设备的状态，并更新孪生场景中的对应状态。 利用经过校准的场景，该智能体在孪生场景中规划机器人的运动，并将生成的轨迹发送至物理执行端点以控制机器人。 该孪生场景始终是物理实验室的实时副本，会随着新观测数据的到来而持续更新。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates laboratory skills at three levels: device execution interfaces, embodied operations, and scientific procedures and interpretation. The agent develops missing skills and interfaces as these requirements arise, building the operational capabilities needed to complete the task.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了三个层级的实验室技能：设备执行接口、具身操作以及科学程序与解释。 科学需求催生了对具身技能的需求，而这些技能又依赖于设备接口所提供的能力。 随着这些需求的出现，智能体会发展出缺失的技能和接口，从而构建完成该任务所需的操作能力。

paragraphs.en: Physical skills that enable the robot to perform experimental tasks are developed by the agent in simulation and on the real robot. In simulation, the agent maps the required experimental operations onto available equipment and explores candidate action sequences through trial and error. Specifically, using object states, the agent automatically defines grasping and placement poses, then uses a motion planner [ 47 ] to generate collision-free trajectories through the cluttered laboratory workspace. It composes these motion segments into an experimental workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 使机器人能够执行实验任务的物理技能，由智能体在模拟环境和真实机器人上共同开发。 在模拟环境中，智能体将所需的实验操作映射到可用设备，并通过试错法探索候选动作序列。 具体来说，智能体利用物体状态自动定义抓取和放置姿态，然后使用运动规划器 [47] 生成穿越杂乱实验室工作空间且无碰撞的运动轨迹。 它将这些运动片段组合成一个实验工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Direct transfer of a workflow from simulation to the real world is bounded by calibration and modelling errors. Transport and coarse localization can often be directly deployed. On the other hand, precise interactions, like grasping and insertion that require millimetre-scale precision, are more sensitive to these errors. There, online exploration is needed. The agent can autonomously use local sensory feedback to refine those interactions on the real robot. During exploration, it selects actions based on visual observations, depth measurements, robot state, and force/torque feedback, then examines the resulting sensory responses to identify successful strategies. Through this process, it learns to interpret feedback and use it to guide subsequent actions. Placement into a constrained fixture, for example, can involve visual alignment, guarded descent, contact detection, lateral adjustment, and resumed insertion after the measured load decreases.
paragraphs.zh: 将工作流程直接从模拟环境转移到现实世界时，会受到校准和建模误差的限制。 运输和粗略定位通常可以直接部署。 另一方面，需要毫米级精度的精确交互（如抓取和插入）对这些误差更为敏感。 在这种情况下，需要进行在线探索。 智能体可以自主利用局部感官反馈，在真实机器人上优化这些交互操作。 在探索过程中，它会根据视觉观察、深度测量、机器人状态以及力/扭矩反馈来选择动作，然后分析由此产生的感官响应，以识别成功的策略。 通过这一过程，它能学会解读反馈，并利用反馈指导后续动作。 例如，将物体放置到受限夹具中可能涉及视觉对齐、受控下降、接触检测、横向调整，以及在测量到的负载下降后重新开始插入。

paragraphs.en: The agent is capable of completing a range of tasks using this approach, through repeated cycles of reasoning, code generation, physical action, and observation. However, these cycles were too slow to meet the requirements of a chemical workflow. To reuse the experience gained during exploration, successful action sequences and their associated feedback are distilled into executable skills. Once an agent establishes a procedure that is repeatable, it is encoded as a Python script containing deterministic actions, sensor-based conditions, and recovery branches, then tested through repeated physical execution. The resulting skill can then run without agent involvement during nominal operation. Agentic reasoning resumes only when execution departs from the conditions encoded with the skill.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体能够利用这种方法完成一系列任务，其过程包括推理、代码生成、物理动作和观察的反复循环。 然而，这些循环的速度太慢，无法满足化学工作流程的要求。 为了复用探索过程中获得的经验，成功的一系列动作及其相关的反馈会被提炼为可执行的技能。 一旦智能体确立了一个可重复的流程，该流程就会被编码为包含确定性动作、基于传感器的条件和恢复分支的 Python 脚本，然后通过反复的物理执行进行测试。 在正常运行期间，由此产生的技能无需智能体的参与即可运行。 只有当执行过程偏离了与技能一同编码的条件时，智能体的推理才会重新介入。

paragraphs.en: Safety is a critical consideration when deploying autonomous agents in physical laboratories, particularly in environments shared with human researchers [ 48 , 49 , 50 ] . To address this challenge, SBL incorporates safety mechanisms at both the simulation and physical execution levels. Specifically, beyond collision-free motion planning, SBL enables safety discovery by leveraging AI agents to autonomously propose and evaluate potentially hazardous scenarios in simulation. Through large-scale exploration of possible failure conditions, we demonstrate that SBL identifies potential risks and generates candidate safety guidelines that can be incorporated into subsequent workflow planning. These findings also provide a foundation for building a shared knowledge base of laboratory hazards and safety practices. During physical execution, SBL implements multiple layers of safety guardrails. A separate control interface allows human operators to stop the entire experimental workflow at any time. Additionally, SBL enforces speed limits on robot trajectories and continuously monitors onboard force sensors to detect unexpected contact and trigger protective stops. Together, these capabilities extend SBL beyond conventional safety enforcement toward proactive hazard discovery and risk-aware autonomous laboratory operation.

paragraphs.en: One of the major challenges in laboratory automation is scalability, as existing systems are often tailored to specific hardware configurations and experimental workflows [ 17 , 19 ] . SBL addresses this challenge by automatically designing, evaluating, and optimizing laboratory configurations in simulation before physical deployment. We demonstrate its scalability across increasingly complex setups, from single-arm and bimanual robotic systems to multi-station laboratories, where mobile robots coordinate material transfer between workstations. This enables SBL to adapt laboratory layouts, robotic configurations, and experimental workflows to different automation requirements.

paragraphs.en: We first demonstrate the adaptability of SBL to a solid-handling workstation, as shown in Figure 6 . The task involves dispensing solid materials into six vials and transferring the vial rack to the opposite side of the workbench for subsequent experiments. SBL first reconstructs a digital twin from images of the physical laboratory, including particle-based simulation of solid dispensing. Since the vial and vial rack designs are not specified by the user, SBL automatically generates CAD models that ensure secure vial placement and robotic graspability. Furthermore, a central shelf prevents the smaller UR3 robot from directly transporting the vial rack across the workbench. To overcome this constraint, SBL autonomously plans a collision-free handoff between the UR3 and UR5 robots, enabling the completion of the task through coordinated bimanual-independent robot manipulation.

paragraphs.en: Fixed-base robot arms are constrained by their limited workspace, while practical chemistry workflows often require devices distributed across multiple workstations. To demonstrate the scalability of SBL beyond a single robotic setup, we integrate the previously described UR-based solid-handling workstation with an xArm-based liquid-handling workstation to perform a buffer preparation workflow. Given only the high-level experimental goal, SBL autonomously generates a workflow that coordinates multiple robotic platforms and laboratory instruments. Specifically, SBL first leverages the UR workstation for solid dispensing, then plans and generates actions for a wheeled mobile manipulator to transport the vial rack between workstations. At the xArm workstation, the system coordinates the placement of the rack into an Opentrons liquid handler for reagent dispensing, followed by transfer to a shaker for mixing. This demonstration highlights the ability of SBL to extend existing robotic setups into an interconnected laboratory by automatically coordinating task allocation, inter-workstation transportation, and instrument operation.

paragraphs.en: SBL brings the development of experimental capabilities into the scientific process. In our implementation this meant two kinds of work: adding control that was missing, such as a joint-servoing interface for the arm, and establishing the conditions under which an operation succeeds, such as feedback-guided insertion where scene calibration was not precise enough. Fine insertion became possible only after force and torque sensing exposed contact conditions that cameras and scene calibration could not [ 55 ] . paragraphs.zh: 智能体能够构建什么，取决于实验室基础设施允许它观察和验证的内容 [ 53 ]。 某些设备故障并未通过 api 产生任何错误，导致智能体无法区分成功与失败 [ 54 ]。 只有在力和扭矩感知揭示了摄像头和场景校准无法检测到的接触条件之后，精细插入才成为可能 [ 55 ]。 对这些信息来源进行解读和权衡仍然需要人类的专家知识。

paragraphs.en: The digital twin also plays a role in safety. Simulation supports trajectory planning, collision checks, and exploration of hazardous scenarios before physical execution. The resulting constraints inform workflow planning and runtime guardrails, including robot speed limits and force-triggered protective stops. These guardrails must not rely on the model refusing unsafe instructions: tests on real robots show that GPT-6-Astra and other models will follow them [ 56 ] . The validity of twin-based checks depends on the geometry, device states, and physical interactions represented in the twin [ 57 ] . Collision checking covers modelled geometry; chemical hazards and uncertain contact conditions, such as the millimetre-scale grasping and placement in our workflow, require additional checks during physical execution. Safe capability development therefore requires both a space for exploration and enforced limits on physical actions, with observations from execution used to refine the twin and its constraints [ 48 , 50 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 数字孪生也在安全方面发挥着作用。 模拟支持在物理执行之前进行轨迹规划、碰撞检查以及对危险场景的探索。 由此产生的约束条件为工作流程规划和运行时防护机制提供了依据，包括机器人速度限制和由力触发的保护性停止。 这些防护机制不能依赖模型拒绝不安全指令：对真实机器人的测试表明，GPT-6-Astra 和其他模型仍会执行这些指令 [ 56 ] 。 基于数字孪生的检查是否有效，取决于数字孪生中所表示的几何形状、设备状态和物理相互作用 [ 57 ] 。 碰撞检查涵盖了建模后的几何结构；而化学危害和不确定的接触条件（例如我们工作流程中的毫米级抓取与放置）则需要在物理执行期间进行额外检查。 因此，安全能力的开发既需要探索空间，也需要对物理动作施加强制性限制，同时利用执行过程中的观察结果来优化数字孪生及其约束条件 [ 48 , 50 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Human involvement remains necessary as new operating conditions emerge during long-horizon tasks [ 24 , 12 ] . Agents retrieve documentation, reconcile information, and execute code at a pace that makes continuous human inspection impractical. During development, we observed both actions based on assumptions that required clarification and overly cautious motion decisions that obstructed task progress. Disagreements between agents also produced repeated exchanges that required human intervention to resolve. These experiences identify a communication requirement: the system must surface the assumptions, conflicting evidence, and operational consequences relevant to a decision. Researchers retain responsibility for scientific objectives and supply physical facts that the available interfaces cannot observe. Twin-based checks and runtime guardrails provide a basis for delegating routine verification, while unresolved conditions are brought to the researcher with enough context for intervention. This division directs human expertise towards the unresolved decisions that limit further capability development. This need for expert involvement, in turn, calls for training researchers to work in SBL environments, where human–agent–robot interaction becomes central, in contrast to both traditional human-led discovery and established SDLs running predefined workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 随着长期任务中新的运行条件不断出现，人类的介入仍然不可或缺 [ 24 , 12 ] 。 智能体以人类难以持续检查的速度检索文档、协调信息并执行代码。 在开发过程中，我们观察到两种情况：一种是基于需要澄清的假设采取行动，另一种是过于谨慎的运动决策阻碍了任务进展。 智能体之间的分歧也引发了反复的交互，需要人类介入才能解决。 这些经验表明存在一项沟通需求：系统必须揭示与决策相关的假设、冲突证据和运行后果。 研究人员仍需对科学目标负责，并提供现有接口无法观察到的物理事实。 基于孪生系统的检查和运行时防护机制为委托常规验证提供了基础，而待解决的情况则会附带足够的上下文信息提交给研究人员进行干预。 这种分工将人类的专业知识集中用于那些限制进一步能力发展的未决决策。 这种对专家介入的需求反过来也要求对研究人员进行培训，使其能够在 SBL 环境中工作——在这种环境中，人类、智能体和机器人之间的互动成为核心，这与传统的人类主导探索以及运行预定义工作流的成熟 SDL 截然不同。

paragraphs.en: For this development process to accumulate capability, successful exploration must produce procedures that can be reused [ 58 , 59 ] . Because agentic cycles were too slow for the chemical workflow, successful explorations were distilled into executable policies that run without the language model and return control to the agent when conditions fall outside them. Encoding these conditions makes operational knowledge available for reuse beyond the original exploration. Reuse across changed equipment or layouts requires checking those conditions and validating the adapted procedure [ 60 ] . Related work tests reusable skills with visual feedback in simulation and on real robots [ 43 ] , and programs that check their own outcomes in simulation [ 61 ] . Capability development thus becomes part of the scientific process rather than a prerequisite for it. The next step is to measure whether successive cycles improve task performance and reduce the engineering effort and human intervention needed for new tasks, while retaining validated capabilities. This would provide a quantitative basis for assessing self-improvement in physical ai ( ai ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了使这一开发过程能够积累能力，成功的探索必须产生可重复使用的程序 [ 58 , 59 ] 。 由于智能体循环在化学工作流程中运行过慢，成功的探索被提炼为可执行的策略：这些策略无需语言模型即可运行，并在条件超出其范围时将控制权交还智能体。 将这些条件编码化，使得操作知识能够在最初的探索之外被重复使用。 在设备或布局发生变化的情况下实现重复使用，需要检查这些条件并验证调整后的程序 [ 60 ] 。 相关研究通过模拟和真实机器人测试了具备视觉反馈的可重复使用技能 [ 43 ] ，以及能够在模拟中自我验证结果的程序 [ 61 ] 。 因此，能力开发成为科学过程的一部分，而非其前提条件。 下一步是衡量连续循环是否提升了任务表现、减少了新任务所需的工程投入和人工干预，同时保留已验证的能力。 这将为实现物理人工智能（ai）的自评估提供量化依据。

paragraphs.en: A global community of researchers can extend this process across laboratories by sharing the resources needed to develop and assess new capabilities [ 62 , 63 , 12 , 64 , 65 ] . Shareable resources include equipment models and digital-twin assets, device interfaces, operational skills, execution records, and safety guidelines accompanied by their applicability and validation conditions. Shared safety standards would provide a common basis for assessing these resources, while deployment in another laboratory would still require local checks [ 50 ] . A global capability map of sdl would connect scientific objectives to available instruments, skills, and resources, and expose the gaps that further capability development must address [ 12 , 62 ] . Such a map could support planning investigations that draw on capabilities distributed across laboratories. The result is a dynamic ecosystem for sbl , in which scientific infrastructure evolves alongside scientific inquiry. The case for self-building laboratories is strongest where engineers cannot follow the equipment: remote field stations, contaminated or hazardous sites, and even laboratories in space, which must operate under constraints on resources, communication, and crew time and develop new capabilities from what is already on board [ 66 , 67 ] .

paragraphs.en: The experimental platform comprised a five-degree-of-freedom xArm5 robotic manipulator mounted on a motorized linear rail and equipped with a parallel gripper (BIO GRIPPER G2) and a 6-axis force/torque sensor for microplate handling (UFACTORY). The rail extended the robot’s access across the liquid-handling, sealing, and measurement stations. Liquid dispensing was performed using an Opentrons OT-2 pipetting robot equipped with an eight-channel pipette (P300 Gen2) on the left, and a single-channel pipette (P1000 Gen2) on the right. The microplates were sealed using an Agilent PlateLoc Thermal Microplate Sealer and characterized using a BioTek Cytation5 multimode reader. We used 19-mm-tall 96-well flat bottom (Agilent 201242-100) and 45-mm-tall deep 96-well U-shape bottom (Agilent 5043-9302) polypropylene microplates. Intel RealSense D435i and D405 RGB-D cameras provided laboratory observations and close-range views of manipulation interfaces. Each instrument was exposed as an authenticated HTTP service with a read-only GET /status endpoint, an OpenAPI schema, and documentation of available functions and valid input ranges.
paragraphs.zh: 该实验平台由一个五自由度 xArm5 机器人机械臂组成，其安装在电动线性导轨上，并配备了平行夹爪（BIO GRIPPER G2）和用于微孔板操作的六轴力/扭矩传感器（UFACTORY）。 该导轨使机器人能够跨越液体处理、密封和测量工作站进行作业。 液体分配由一台 Opentrons OT-2 移液机器人完成，其左侧配备八通道移液器（P300 Gen2），右侧配备单通道移液器（P1000 Gen2）。 微孔板使用 Agilent PlateLoc 热微孔板密封机进行密封，并通过 BioTek Cytation5 多模式读数仪进行特性分析。 我们使用了高度为 19 毫米的 96 孔平底聚丙烯微孔板（Agilent 201242-100）和高度为 45 毫米的深 96 孔 U 形底聚丙烯微孔板（Agilent 5043-9302）。 Intel RealSense D435i 和 D405 RGB-D 摄像头提供了实验室观察视角以及对操作界面的近距离视图。 每台设备均以经过身份验证的 HTTP 服务形式提供，包含只读 GET /status 端点、OpenAPI 模式以及可用功能和有效输入范围的文档说明。

paragraphs.en: We used openai-gpt6-astra to construct and modify laboratory representations, generate experimental workflows, and invoke planning and equipment-control tools. The digital twin was implemented in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.1 using usd ( usd ) [ 68 ] . Equipment representations were assembled from available cad models, reconstructed geometry, laboratory photographs, and device documentation. Articulated components were represented using joints, while liquid-handling states tracked liquid volume and composition. Robot motion planning used cuRobo [ 47 ] with robot collision-sphere representations and environment obstacles represented by meshes and cuboids. Collision checking was performed within the GPU planning pipeline. During workflow execution in the physical laboratory, all commands were issued through equipment-specific APIs, and robot and instrument status were recorded during operation. Measurement responses were saved incrementally as CSV files, together with run metadata. All machines connect through a private Tailscale network. Agents interact with instruments through two interfaces: REST and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). For REST requests, the central API checks the agent’s authorization and records each device claim. The agent then sends commands directly to the instrument with the claim token. The MCP interface provides access to a selected set of approved tools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 openai-gpt6-astra 构建和修改实验室表示，生成实验工作流程，并调用规划与设备控制工具。 该数字孪生体在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.1 中通过 usd ( usd ) [ 68 ] 实现。 设备表示由可用的 cad 模型、重建的几何结构、实验室照片和设备文档组装而成。 可动组件通过关节表示，而液体处理状态则跟踪液体体积和成分。 机器人运动规划使用 cuRobo [ 47 ]，其中机器人碰撞球体表示和环境的障碍物由网格和长方体表示。 碰撞检测在 GPU 规划流程中执行。 在物理实验室中执行工作流程期间，所有命令均通过设备特定的 API 发出，并在操作过程中记录机器人和仪器的状态。 测量响应与运行元数据一同以 CSV 文件的形式增量保存。 所有机器都通过一个私有的 Tailscale 网络连接。 智能体通过两种接口与仪器交互：REST 和模型上下文协议（MCP）。 对于 REST 请求，中央 API 会检查智能体的授权并记录对每个设备的占用声明。 随后，智能体使用该占用令牌直接向仪器发送命令。 MCP 接口提供对一组经过批准的工具的访问权限。
